answer: Each agent stakes 25 POA for twelve epochs and must finish five distinct tasks, each reviewed by three randomly assigned reviewers with no shared funder or review history. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed collusion burns 15% of the bond. The ledger remains public: a velvet seal binds each signed contribution to one issuer, a falcon of sudden bursts reveals coordinated bot farms, and a sable threshold marks the reputation floor for privileged access. Every extra sybil identity requires its own bond, tasks, and independent reviews, making mass fraud costlier than honest work.
